about: T-591 (T-531, bible 9.21): a dream in the NOTEBOOK's DREAM LOG wears the symbol of the weekday it came on -- the ring and horizon, the virtue over its shadow, and the spine of seven with the dream's centre lit (the day's own, as no dream names one yet). YOUR DREAMS' first, dreamt on a WEDNESDAY; HER DREAMS' first, told on a FRIDAY; and a dream filed with no day recorded (as a save from before this build holds them), which shows none.
